trust_decision.summary: Which A-label a Unicode host label maps to (and whether an incoming A-label round-trips) is decided by URI::_idna::nameprep, which only lowercases and never applies Unicode normalization, so non-NFC labels encode to non-standard A-labels and non-NFC A-labels pass the decode round-trip check.

landing_point.why: The summary names nameprep; the function carries an explicit 'XXX real implementation missing' comment and is the only IDNA normalization step.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal helper module (underscore-prefixed IDNA/nameprep implementation) shared by all server-type schemes

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; the only arguable dismissal is that full RFC 3491 nameprep (prohibited/bidi tables) is out of scope, which the published fix itself also leaves unimplemented (fix.diff:81-82).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hosts passed as bytes are treated as Latin-1 (UTF-8 bytes for 'ü' encode to xn--ri-sample-fra0f and ihost/as_iri return the same bytes); a fix that UTF-8-decodes or otherwise re-interprets host bytes, or NFKC-folds, breaks this documented contract. ASCII labels also bypass nameprep (case preserved).

O6_input_shapes: non-NFC Unicode label on encode (URI->new / host setter / URI::_idna::encode), e.g. U+0958 U+093E -> xn--11b2fg (fix.diff:113-114)
non-NFC A-label on decode (ihost / as_iri / URI::_idna::decode) now rejected by the existing round-trip check because ToASCII re-normalizes (fix.diff:122-123; lib/URI/_idna.pm:84-86)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: canonical() lowercases the host but does not re-derive A-labels; a planted IDNA re-canonicalisation here with its own lc-only normalization would be a second normalizer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: canonical() is the documented place for host normalization and already does host-specific rewriting (lc, port stripping).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: authority() setter percent-escapes a non-ASCII host instead of IDNA-encoding it; a planted IDNA path here calling encode_punycode directly would bypass nameprep
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: host() setter IDNA-encodes via _host_escape but authority() does not; a maintainer aligning the two could call the punycode primitive directly.

O9_family: input canonicalisation / Unicode normalization (CWE-1289) leading to host identity differential between URI and other IDNA clients

O10_build.toolchain: perl >= 5.8.1, ExtUtils::MakeMaker / cpanm (cpanfile); fix adds core module Unicode::Normalize

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Normalize the host in URI::_server::_host_escape (encode side only) or use NFKC per RFC 3491, leaving decode/ihost accepting non-NFC A-labels or folding compatibility characters.

out_of_scope_notes: Full nameprep prohibited-character and bidi checks remain unimplemented at and after the fix (fix.diff:81-82).
Non-_server schemes (URI::_foreign, file, mailto) never IDNA-encode hosts; non-ASCII hosts are percent-escaped (lib/URI.pm:144-150), so they are not routes into this sink.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo inferred from a ~70-file pure-Perl lib/ tree.
present_in_latest not applicable (no latest release given and O8 empty).
Whether all four entry points funnel exclusively through nameprep was checked by grep for _idna/punycode callers in lib/ only (lib/URI/_server.pm:30-31,45-46,104-105).
